conviction_note: The event this print is keyed to — a 6-K accepted 2026-09-01T20:52 UTC — postdates the actual release: Rezolve put out H1 2026 results and held its call before the open that morning and the stock was already down 19% on 43.8m shares by 11:06 ET, so the measured window is aftermath, and inside that aftermath the two hard numbers I can pin down (only $33.2m of $100.5m cash unrestricted, against a roughly $300m buyback management would not take questions on) point down rather than up on a 105%-vol name that closed near its low.

findings.finding: The market had already fully reacted to this print before the filing that defines it: the results release and earnings call landed pre-open on 2026-09-01, the stock fell from a 2.89 prior close to 2.34 by 11:06 ET on 43.8m shares against a 19.8m twenty-day average, and closed at 2.39 — near the low — while the 6-K carrying the actual financial statements was not accepted until 20:52 UTC (16:52 ET), which puts the detailed disclosure inside the measured window rather than before it.

findings.why_not_priced: This is not a claim about the company being mispriced but about the event window being mis-specified, and nothing in the wire copy or in the baseline reflects it: the baseline books the 19.26% fall as run_up_5d_pct, i.e. it treats the reaction as run-in, and gives the name a null expected_move_pct with a 6.62% one-day-vol deadband, which would size a fresh earnings gap that cannot happen twice. What the window does contain is the after-the-close 6-K with the full statements on a day the stock closed on its low, which is where the detail gets read.

findings.finding: On the 2026-09-01 call, disclosure quoted repeatedly in the pre-seal thread puts total cash at $100.5m but unrestricted cash at only $33.2m, against a roughly $300m buyback the company had announced, and management ended the call saying no online questions had been submitted — leaving the buyback and the 2027 outlook unaddressed — while H1 net loss was about $139m of which $67.5m was non-cash ($41.5m share-based comp, $20.4m D&A, $5.6m impairment).

findings.why_not_priced: The intraday move priced the headline loss and the revenue reiteration; the unrestricted-versus-total cash split is a balance-sheet detail that only appears in the statements filed after the close, and the corpus contains zero news items for this name, so no sell-side or wire summary existed to propagate it. An issuer with $33.2m unrestricted cash that has filed two F-3 shelves (2025-11-28, 2025-12-19) and three prospectus supplements (424B7 2025-11-07, 424B3 2025-12-30, 424B5 2026-01-21) in the last ten months has an obvious next move, and a buyback nine times its unrestricted cash is not it.

baseline_tension: This cuts squarely against the baseline's framing rather than against its level: the baseline records the 19.26% five-day fall as run-up and leaves expected_move_pct null, whereas the corpus shows that fall to be the earnings reaction itself, which means the forward window should be sized as post-event drift and not as an unpriced 105%-vol gamma event.
corpus_limits: No option chain, and no reaction history at all — the baseline found zero recoverable prior prints for this foreign private issuer, so expected_move_pct is null and the 6.62% deadband is one day of realised vol, not a print base rate. The load-bearing caveat: the seal's print time (2026-09-01T20:52 UTC) is later than the public release and the call, so the Stocktwits thread fetched at 15:06 UTC is pre-print by the corpus's own definition and carries no tripwire flag, yet in substance it reports the results. I used it only to establish that the reaction had already occurred and to read the cash disclosure; nothing I read speaks to 2026-09-02, so there is no look-ahead into the measured window, but a reader should treat both findings as resting on that one unusual document. Its content is retail paraphrase of a call transcript I do not have, with posters disagreeing about figures ($67.5m of non-cash charges quoted variously with $41.5m and $47m of share comp), so the numbers carry paraphrase risk. No filing body is stored for the 13D/A, the Form 4, the 425 or the 20-F. No document in this capture carried a tripwire flag.
